description: A /connect page opened before the agent runs grant never updates; it keeps showing the new-drive form (including 'Add to an existing drive instead'). The owner must reload to see the offer. If they approve the stale page the result is a brand-new drive, not the drive the agent offered.
expected: The page picks up the offer (polling or refresh on approve) or warns that the request changed, as it does for changed offers.
actual: step-3a-stale-page.png shows no 'Offered by' text after the grant.
suggested_fix: Poll the pairing request every few seconds while unapproved, or have Approve revalidate and return 'The request changed'.

description: The permissions the owner is approving (drive, read/write, write path) sit in a grey run-on sentence with the same weight as boilerplate. When the offer changes, the notice 'The request changed; review it again.' is the same neutral box and the changed value is not highlighted, so a widened offer (for example read to read+write) looks just like a narrowed one.
expected: Show drive, access and write path as labelled rows (like AGENT, MACHINE); highlight what changed.
suggested_fix: Add DRIVE / ACCESS / WRITES rows to the details table; style the changed notice as a warning.

description: The CLI prints the request time as raw ISO UTC ('made 2026-11-06T19:04:11.325Z') while the page shows the same moment as '11/6/2026, 2:04:11 PM' local time, so the owner cannot easily match the two. Also the offer says 'drive research-bot', which is ambiguous when the agent and the drive share a name.
expected: Same time format (or a relative 'a minute ago') in both places; label 'Drive: research-bot'.
suggested_fix: Format time as local in the CLI, or show the UTC value with zone on the page.
